questions.question: Where does the psalmist lift up his eyes in Psalm 121?
From where does the psalmist's help come?
options: From the king, who sits upon his throne
From the LORD, who made heaven and earth
From the temple, where the priests minister
From the hills, where the watchmen stand
questions.answer: From the LORD, who made heaven and earth

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in from this time forth and _____.
